newsitem.title: FRANCE: France busts "Cat Connection" ring, seizes skins.
newsitem.headline: France busts "Cat Connection" ring, seizes skins.

text.p: French officials have seized 1,800 cat skins at a clandestine plant used to supply makers of fake fur coats, an animal rights group said on Monday.

Denouncing what it called a "Cat Connection", named after the long-defunct "French Connection" drugs ring, the ANTAC association against animal trafficking said the plant's owner would face charges of illicit trade in protected species.
ANTAC said in a statement that the building in which dead animals were skinned, located near Bressuire outside Bordeaux in southwestern France, had been raided by veterinary services.
The plant was supplied by gamekeepers and specialist companies, the statement said.
Officials also found the skins of 80 deer and 27 weasels.
